title: The Hanging of the Lake
description: On the first day of thaw, villagers pin a sheet of lake water to a clothesline. The mountain still hangs upside down in it as the water drips back into the lake.
alt: Two villagers on wooden piers clip a dripping sheet of lake water to a line. An upside-down snowy mountain appears in the hanging water.
pairing: First thaw holiday × hanging the lake surface on a clothesline
